newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania agency appeals Azomures ruling.
newsitem.headline: Romania agency appeals Azomures ruling.

text.p: Romania's main privatisation agency said on Wednesday it had appealed against a court ruling forbidding it to cancel a contract with a local trader on the sale of a majority stake in fertiliser maker Azomures.

"We will open fresh talks with the second bidder for the Azomures stake five days after we win a cancellation of the court decision," Stefan Ciochinaru, spokesman for the State Ownership Fund (FPS), told Reuters.

The FPS, which has a control stake in most Romanian state enterprises, announced a month ago the cancellation of its contract to sell 51 percent in listed Azomures to Euro Trading Chemicals over the trader's failure to pay for the stake.

Euro Trading had been the successful bidder in a February tender for Azomures shares. The bidding triggered an inquiry by Romania's main competition supervisor into a possible "economic concentration" in the fertiliser industry by the trader, which already got stakes in another two fertiliser units.

The company asked a court to rule on the suspension of Azomures payment pending the results of the investigation. It won a ruling, which also suspended a FPS contract clause saying the deal could be annulled on failure to pay.
"We showed the court that the grounds on which the ruling was passed were not justified and we now expect a cancellation of that ruling," Ciochinaru said, declining to elaborate.

If the ruling gets cancelled, the FPS would start talks with rival bidder Omnimpex local trader. Under a deal signed at the tender, Omnimpex was entitled to fresh negotiations on the Azomures selloff if Euro Trading failed to pay.
Azomures, a Bucharest bourse first-tier stock heavily traded since it joined the exchange last January, has a share capital of 209.5 billion lei.
Omnimpex said it was ready to maintain its initial offer for Azomures at 90,000 lei per share, which will bring the total worth of the deal to 384 billion lei. ($=7,177 lei)
